inputs: plain-language project brief | 5 V / 2 A / 50 °C limits | laboratory and course rules
actions: Explain | Fix limits | Assign roles | Assess risk | Review
safety: no construction before approval | no chemical work by students alone | unknown hazards stop the phase
evidence: one-paragraph mission | approved risk assessment | named team roles | baseline limits table
handoff: Proceed to calculations and printer coupons.

inputs: trial length, width and thickness | copper resistivity | printer and material choice
actions: Calculate area | Predict resistance | Predict heating | Print coupons | Update rules
safety: convert units before calculating | guard hot printer surfaces | record failed coupons rather than hiding them
evidence: checked calculation sheet | three measured coupons | printer capability table | revised design rules
handoff: Use measured rules to build the loggers and freeze designs.

inputs: 5 V current-limited supply | current shunt and voltage converter | four digital temperature sensors
actions: Build fixture | Measure current | Measure sample | Add temperature | Calibrate
safety: 2.5 A fuse and main switch | guard load resistors | invalid sensor or 50 °C reading stops the test
evidence: wiring diagram | firmware and channel map | calibration table | fault and stop test record
handoff: Provide verified measurements to the software phase.

inputs: mission limits | geometry and material values | Comma-Separated Values measurement format
actions: Store inputs | Calculate | Read data | Test code | Report
safety: software never replaces the physical stop | retain original raw data | failed tests block later analysis
evidence: readable source files | automated test results | example input dataset | reproducible report output
handoff: Use the verified model during design freeze and testing.

inputs: coupon-derived print rules | electrical predictions | common 100 mm × 30 mm envelope
actions: Design A | Design B | Design C | Freeze | Print and label
safety: qualify both nozzles on coupons | do not change frozen geometry silently | inspect sharp or failed prints before use
evidence: three frozen design files | nine labelled bases | dimension and mass record | failed-print and change log
handoff: Release identified samples to supervised seeding and plating.

inputs: clean labelled bases and coupons | approved printed or applied seed | approved copper-plating process
actions: Clean and mask | Apply seed | Check coupons | Plate copper | Rinse and inspect
safety: laboratory owns chemistry and waste | approved Personal Protective Equipment | no student bath changes or unsupervised plating
evidence: completed process travellers | seed resistance and voltage-drop record | before/after mass and photographs | defect and continuity map
handoff: Release plated samples only after laboratory and traceability review.

inputs: nine plated samples | verified fixture and loggers | randomized sample order
actions: Inspect | Connect | Run levels | Repeat | Compare
safety: stop above 2 A or at 50 °C | stop on invalid sensor or loose connection | stop for smoke, smell or unexpected heating
evidence: raw time-series tables | resistance and temperature plots | uncertainty note | three-design comparison and yield
handoff: Select one repair-ready sample for controlled damage.

inputs: tested repair-ready sample | approved damage location | repair mask and laboratory access
safety: contain sharp edges and particles | record damage before repair | repair plating remains laboratory controlled
evidence: original/damaged/repaired dataset | matched photographs | repair time and material cost | electrical and thermal recovery result
handoff: Send the complete evidence package to business comparison and reporting.

inputs: source code and calculations | manufacturing and test evidence | Bill of Materials and actual costs
actions: Validate | Compare value | Explain limits | Review | Recommend
safety: separate facts from interpretation | do not hide failures or uncertainty | do not claim industrial or commercial proof
evidence: first-year engineering report | one-page business summary | reproducible data and code package | final presentation and decision
handoff: Archive the project passport and approved next-step recommendation.
